title: PredActBench: Benchmarking Tool-Augmented Dialogue under Controlled Tool Noise
abstract: arXiv:2608.02372v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly used to support decisions by calling external tools. Existing work on LLM tool-calling assumes these tools are perfectly reliable. However, in many applications, the tools are statistical predictors with non-trivial errors. We introduce PredActBench, a benchmark for evaluating dialogue agents that work with imperfect predictive tools, using education as a testbed. First, we build a benchmark in which LLMs work with noisy predictors to guide users' decisions. Second, we extend two prior metrics for trust calibration, Relative AI-Reliance and Relative Self-Reliance, to multi-turn dialogue. Third, we evaluate 13 LLMs on OULAD and our released PredAct-CS dataset of 60 courses with real final grades and synthetic weekly scores, alongside a human study involving 13 instructors and teaching assistants. We find that when tools are noisy, SOTA models rarely make predictor uncertainty visible

translated_title: PredActBench：在可控工具噪声下对工具增强对话进行基准测试
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地被用于通过调用外部工具来支持决策。现有关于LLM工具调用的工作通常假设这些工具是完全可靠的。然而，在许多实际应用中，这些工具是带有不可忽视误差的统计预测器。我们提出了PredActBench，这是一个用于评估与不完美预测工具协同工作的对话智能体的基准，并以教育领域作为测试平台。首先，我们构建了一个基准，让LLM与带噪声的预测器协同工作以引导用户的决策。其次，我们将两个已有的信任校准指标——相对AI依赖度和相对自我依赖度——扩展到多轮对话场景中。第三，我们在OULAD数据集和我们发布的PredAct-CS数据集（包含60门课程的真实期末成绩和合成的每周分数）上评估了13个LLM，并开展了一项涉及13名教师和助教的人类研究。我们发现，当工具存在噪声时，最先进的模型很少将预测器的不确定性向用户显现出来。
tldr: 该论文提出PredActBench基准，首次系统评估了LLM对话智能体在不完美预测工具（含噪声）下的表现，并将信任校准指标扩展到多轮对话，发现最先进的模型很少向用户显现预测工具的不确定性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PredActBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLM dialogue agents working with noisy predictive tools, extends trust calibration metrics to multi-turn dialogue, and finds that SOTA models rarely make predictor uncertainty visible to users.
